infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Verdant Path reads sleep, HRV, and activity data to compute your daily fatigue score.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Verdant Path can write workout data to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Verdant Path uses photos for progress pictures in your journal.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Verdant Path can remind you of workouts when you arrive at the gym.
